checkedAlternates.risk: Choux pastry puffs up dramatically without yeast.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Choux relies purely on trapped water turning into steam (group-1), not chemical baking soda/powder (group-3).
Sourdough uses a wild symbiotic lactobacilli/yeast starter culture (group-2), distinct from commercial Saccharomyces cerevisiae baker’s yeast (group-4).
